remarks:
Setting on approximately 1.8 acres, this recreational getaway at 8506 Seneca Way offers the perfect escape to enjoy the outdoors in beautiful Allegany County. The sale includes a well-maintained Bayridge travel trailer camper, storage shed, and an additional area already set up for an RV hookup, making this ideal for hosting family and friends or expanding your seasonal camping setup. There is a drilled well, electric, and a septic already on site. Relax on the covered deck and take in the peaceful wooded surroundings while enjoying your morning coffee or evening campfire. Located in a private setting with nearby access to thousands of acres of state land, this property is perfectly situated for hunting, hiking, fishing, and recreation. Conveniently located near Rushford Lake, Cuba Lake, and the Genesee River, you’ll have easy access to boating, fishing, kayaking, and countless recreational opportunities.
Whether you are looking for a weekend retreat, seasonal camp, or affordable basecamp for outdoor adventures, this property offers a great opportunity to enjoy all that the area has to offer. 
The property is being sold in AS IS condition with a quitclaim deed. Seller does not have a title for the travel trailer. There is a $150 annual fee for road maintenance.
